# ui::ScrollProvider

Header: `winui/ui/Automation.hpp`.

The [Scroll](../layout/scroll.md#uiscroll) pattern: how far a view is scrolled ([Scroll](../layout/scroll.md#uiscroll), VirtualList, [TableView](../controls/table-view.md#uitableview)). Implement every member.

## scroll_horizontal_percent

```cpp
virtual float scroll_horizontal_percent() const = 0
```

Percent scrolled horizontally in [0, 100], or -1 when that axis does not scroll (0 is scrollable, at the start).

## scroll_vertical_percent

```cpp
virtual float scroll_vertical_percent() const = 0
```

As [scroll_horizontal_percent()](#scroll_horizontal_percent), for the vertical axis.

## set_scroll_percent

```cpp
virtual bool set_scroll_percent(float horizontal, float vertical) = 0
```

[Scroll](../layout/scroll.md#uiscroll) each axis to a percentage in [0, 100]; -1 leaves that axis alone. True when it scrolled.

## ~ScrollProvider

```cpp
~ScrollProvider() = default
```
